subject: encode-cpu: taking async submit frontend hooks (compute_frontend.m teguExecute); bridge untouched for now
body: Per root I own the userspace async-submit side. Step A (now, compute_frontend.m only): enable via n2mb_async(conn,1) at device open (probe WAIT_SEQ once; old kernels stay sync; NORD2_METAL_ASYNC=0 forces sync), n2mb_wait_pending before CPU blits/fills, genericPreclear and CPU index re-expansion, one reap at command end before shadow sync/presents/status, failed_job -> job index attribution in TEGU_COMMAND_FAILED. New host test with a deferred-execution WAIT_SEQ fake (writes become visible only when reaped, in-order, 96 window busy, failure injection) under gpu/build/encode-cpu-20261026/. Step B (later, needs a small additive bridge function, will post the exact hunk first): cross-command GPU pipelining = per-command seq wait outside the bridge lock (n2mb_wait_seq). I will not touch your preload regions.
